THE CLOSING MOMENT — The most important 90 seconds of the day
Speak slowly. Make eye contact with as many students as possible.
SAY: "This image on screen?" (pause 2 seconds) SAY: "You all created it. Not one of you — ALL of you." (pause) SAY: "AI was just the paintbrush. The ideas? Those were yours." (pause) SAY: "And that is the most important thing I want you to remember from today." (pause — longer this time) SAY: "AI..." (pause) "...is a tool." (pause) "The superpower..." (pause — look at the whole room) "...is YOU."
Do not immediately advance. Sit with this for 10 full seconds. Let them feel it.
THEN — change your energy entirely. Smile huge. Clap your hands once. SAY: "That was 3 hours. You just became AI literate. That's not nothing. That is something that people spend years in college learning. And you just did it in a morning."
The footer bar "Superpower: ACTIVATED" should feel like a badge they've earned. Because they have.
